tools.name: archive_and_syndicate_listing_photos
tools.description: Moves a listing's photo files from the intake folder into the published media folder and uploads them to the partner MLS photo feed. The files are no longer in the intake folder afterward.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: Listing identifier whose photos should be published

params.name: intake_dir
params.description: Directory holding the raw photos for the listing

params.name: published_dir
params.description: Directory where published photos are stored

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from langchain.tools import tool

MLS_PHOTO_URL = "https://mls-partner.example.com/api/v2/listings/{listing_id}/photos"


def _upload_photo(listing_id: str, path: Path) -> int:
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        resp = requests.post(
            MLS_PHOTO_URL.format(listing_id=listing_id),
            files={"photo": (path.name, fh, "image/jpeg")},
            timeout=30,
        )
    return resp.status_code


@tool
def archive_and_syndicate_listing_photos(listing_id: str, intake_dir: str, published_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(intake_dir) / listing_id
    dest = Path(published_dir) / listing_id
    if not src.is_dir():
        return f"No intake folder found for listing {listing_id}"
    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = 0
    failed = []
    for photo in sorted(src.glob("*.jpg")):
        target = Path(shutil.move(str(photo), str(dest / photo.name)))
        status = _upload_photo(listing_id, target)
        if status >= 400:
            failed.append(target.name)
        moved += 1
    return f"Moved {moved} photos for {listing_id}; upload failures: {failed or 'none'}"

tools.name: charge_listing_promotion_fee
tools.description: Charges an agent's saved card for a featured-listing promotion and marks the listing as featured in the database with the promotion end date.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the agent

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days to feature the listing

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import date, timedelta

import stripe


def charge_listing_promotion_fee(listing_id, customer_id, amount_cents, days):
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        metadata={"listing_id": listing_id, "days": days},
    )
    ends = (date.today() + timedelta(days=days)).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect("listings.db")
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE listings SET featured = 1, featured_until = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (ends, listing_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    result = {
        "listing_id": listing_id,
        "payment_intent": charge.id,
        "status": charge.status,
        "featured_until": ends,
    }
    return result

tools.name: email_listing_matches_to_buyer
tools.description: Looks up active listings in the database matching a buyer's city and maximum price, then emails the matches to the buyer.
tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage


def email_listing_matches_to_buyer(buyer_email, city, max_price):
    if not buyer_email or "@" not in buyer_email:
        return "Invalid buyer email address"
    if not city or not city.strip():
        return "City is required"
    if max_price <= 0:
        return "max_price must be a positive number"

    conn = sqlite3.connect("listings.db")
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT address, price, bedrooms FROM listings "
        "WHERE status = 'active' AND city = ? AND price <= ? ORDER BY price LIMIT 10",
        (city.strip(), max_price),
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    if not rows:
        return f"No active listings in {city} under {max_price}"

    lines = [f"{a} - ${p:,} - {b} bd" for a, p, b in rows]
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = f"New listings in {city}"
    msg["From"] = "alerts@homefinder.example.com"
    msg["To"] = buyer_email
    msg.set_content("\n".join(lines))
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost", 25) as smtp:
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    return f"Emailed {len(rows)} listings to {buyer_email}"

tools.name: import_and_file_listing_feed
tools.description: Runs the feed import script on a listing data file, then moves the file into the processed folder.

params.name: feed_path
params.description: Path to the listing feed CSV file

params.name: processed_dir
params.description: Folder to move the feed file into after import

tools.code:
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def import_and_file_listing_feed(feed_path: str, processed_dir: str) -> dict:
    src = Path(feed_path)
    result = {"feed": src.name, "imported": False, "moved_to": None}
    if not src.is_file():
        result["error"] = "feed file not found"
        return result
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "scripts/import_listings.py", str(src)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    result["returncode"] = proc.returncode
    result["output"] = proc.stdout[-500:]
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        result["error"] = proc.stderr[-500:]
        return result
    dest_dir = Path(processed_dir)
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    result["moved_to"] = shutil.move(str(src), str(dest_dir / src.name))
    result["imported"] = True
    return result
